title: Indigenous Resistance, Resurgence and Revitalization for Helpers
description: Introduces contemporary examples of Indigenous resistance, resurgence and revitalization from local, national and international contexts. Critically examines the implications for social work practice with an emphasis on Indigenous and de--colonial thought and collectivist and community-centred approaches to addressing historical and ongoing colonial policies and practices. Students explore their self-location, ideas, values and beliefs in relation to practice with Indigenous peoples and practice informed by Indigenous knowledges.

prerequisites.text: Admission to the MSW Advanced program
